column1: # Tile patches: labels drawn as BITMAPS rather than text characters.
# The status bar has its own 26-tile mini-font at bank 2 $7C92 (digits, Lv, F, Hp, /,
# %, the meter block, then the fullness label). HP/Lv preserve their one-cell positions;
# FULLNESS is a compressed bitmap spanning tile boundaries. Budgets are therefore PIXELS
